qualitative.gate_2_reason: Primary listing and operations in Poland/CEE outside approved Western developed market universe (in_market=N), alongside discretionary non-essential nature of corporate gym benefit cards.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Need & Market Mandate). Disqualified by pre-screen geographic condition as Poland is outside the approved rule-of-law Western developed market universe (in_market=N). Furthermore, employer-subsidized sports cards are non-essential discretionary corporate perks subject to corporate belt-tightening.
qualitative.evidence: Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange with the bulk of revenue and fitness card memberships generated across Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Bulgaria (in_market=N). Although it possesses strong regional network effects with the MultiSport card, it fails the Western developed market mandate.
